resourceName: Inner Mongolia Genhe Improved Forest Management Project
description: The Inner Mongolia Genhe Improved Forest Management Project is located in the western slope of the northern section of the Greater Khingan Mountains, Hulun Buir City, straddling the cities of Genhe, Yakeshi and Erguna in China. The geographical coordinates of the project area are 120°39′30″E~122°47′05″E, 50°25′10″N~51°45′20″N, with a forest coverage rate of 93.78%. The project is implemented by Genhe Forest Industry Co., LTD, a subsidiary of Inner Mongolia Forest Industry Group (hereafter “project owner”).  Prior to the implementation of the project, the forests in the project area were regarded as commercial forests and harvested annually according to the timber production plan issued by the local forestry bureau. From 15/01/2020 of the project implementation, harvesting has been strictly cancelled by the project owner, allowing only tending and managing. Forest vegetation is overwhelmingly dominant, and the species involved in this project is Larix gmelinii (Rupr.) Kuzen (later called Larch). The project has approximately 36 886.44 ha commercial forest. According to the Non-Permanence Risk Report, with buffering deducting, the estimated annual emission reduction of the project is 296 527.050 tCO2e, and the total estimated emission reductions will reach 8 895 811.502 tCO2e during the 30 years’ crediting period.
